messages:
deploy-bot: ALERT: EU canary for release r-34f2b showing error spike — 5xx from 0.3% -> 12% in last 2m. Paging @sara (oncall).

sara: On call. I see repeated 504s from serve-34{a,b,c} in eu-west. Reproducing locally shows upstream timeouts. Paging @kevin to coordinate rollback plan.

kevin: Looking. Any FFs toggled for the canary cohort? If so, quick flip may be fastest.

sara: Yes — feature flag `rte-new-routing` is true for canary. My initial plan: flip flag scoped to canary (fast kill-switch), pause rollout, then roll back image if errors persist.

james: Heads up flipping that flag will bypass some cache paths and may cause cold-cache latency. Sequence: 1) FF -> off in canary 2) Pause rollout 3) Roll back image if still degraded.

kevin: Agreed. Steps I will run:
1) POST to FF service to set enabled=false for scope=canary
2) Pause canary in Rollout UI
3) If >1% 5xx after 60s, kubectl rollback to v2026-03-16-abc

Example:
```
curl -X POST "https://ff.internal/api/toggles/rte-new-routing" -H "Authorization: Bearer $FF_API" -d '{"enabled":false,"scope":"canary"}'

kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/serve --to-revision=42
```

sara: Toggling flag now.

sara: API returned 200 — flag set to false for canary. :white_check_mark: 

oncall-bot: SYSTEM: Feature flag `rte-new-routing` set to false for scope=canary by sara at 3260001128.

deploy-bot: INFO: Rollout paused for r-34f2b at 3260001145.

kevin: Starting rollback to revision 42 via kubectl. Monitoring pod replacements.

deploy-bot: STATUS: Rollback in progress — 3/5 pods replaced, expected convergence ~120s.

maria: Support: 12 customer tickets (504s) in EU. Notifying CS. Major customers affected: Acme Corp (prod), BetaApps (staging). Holding comms until rollback outcome.

sara: Pushed status to #customer-ops: 'Investigating degraded responses in EU after canary. Rolling back to stable; ETA ~10m.' :loudspeaker:

kevin: Post-rollback verification checklist:
- curl https://health.prod/ -> 200
- python infra/tests/smoke_test.py --seed=smoke1 -> 4/4
- p95 latency < 200ms and 5xx < 0.5%

james: Smoke tests pass (4/4). p95 ~120ms, 5xx ~0.1% over last 5m. Taking ownership for extended verification and metrics watch.

sara: Handoff to @james — I'll monitor for 20m then stand down. Thanks everyone.

ops-lead: Solid mitigation. Action items:
- Create incident doc with timeline and commands used
- Root cause hypothesis: cache/KV invalidation interacting with new routing flag
- Recommend: safety net to auto-flip flag when 5xx > 2% for >1m

customer-ops-bot: CS message posted to affected customers: 'We observed degraded responses for some EU requests after a canary rollout. We rolled back to a stable version; services are restored. We'll follow up with root cause details.'

james: Logged steps, verification, and notes in #incidents/3260001111. Keeping thread open until 30m stable. :white_check_mark:
